sounds.prompt: Seamless steady background ambience of a large enclosed science fiction gladiator arena packed with a distant audience. Hundreds of spectators murmuring, restless low chatter, scattered indistinct calls, subdued rustling, spacious indoor stadium reverberation. Consistent quiet crowd walla without a big swell. Heard from the arena floor far below the stands. No intelligible words, no announcer, no music, no fighting, no close voices.

Seamless steady deep ventilation and electrical machinery hum inside a vast enclosed futuristic arena. Soft distant air handling fans and a restrained low mechanical rumble, cavernous room tone. Consistent quiet industrial ambience. No alarms, no voices, no music, no impacts, no high pitched whine.
